description: Get an app's details by appKey or by shortcut (or a full https://www.pgyer.com/<shortcut> URL): latest version, download page, QR code, install type, install period and download page settings. Pass buildKey together with appKey to get one specific historical build. The install password is never returned.

buildKey.description: A specific build of the app (only with appKey)

shortcut.description: Download page shortcut or URL, e.g. "abcd" or "https://www.pgyer.com/abcd"

name: get_app

appKey.description: Missing when the app could not be found in this account's app list

installPeriod.description: Dates between which the build can be installed; null means no limit

isLatest.description: Whether this build carries PGYER's latest-version mark

versionSource.description: Whether the download page shows PGYER build numbers or the package version code

title: Get app details
